citation: Swain P, et al. Exp Physiol 2026;111:3699
protocol: 6 x 2 min jumping at 40% VO2peak in simulated lunar gravity (about 20% bodyweight) with 1 min rest; the non-BFR visit is the plain-exercise arm; HR and VO2 each set, blood lactate at rest and after each set
population: 14 healthy adults (11 M, 3 F), 24 +/- 4 y, VO2peak 50 +/- 11 mL/kg/min
note: Unusual exercise mode (jumping with head-up tilt suspension) but a clean low-intensity bout; read the non-BFR rows. Lactate barely moves without BFR.
